column5: What if a whale swallowed you?
You float in the open ocean.
The mouth opens wider than a house.
Muscles crush you down the throat.
No whale can swallow a human.
A blue whale's throat is only grapefruit-sized.
A sperm whale's throat fits barely a large fish.
The eighteen ninety-one James Bartley story was fake.
Sperm whales dive two thousand meters deep.
They hold their breath for ninety minutes.
You are not on the menu.
Would you still swim with giants?
